text: David Cooper, Principal & Founder, Leading Mobility, will address the TTC Board. This presentation will discuss current safety trends and their impact on transit systems, as well as how peer transit agencies are addressing societal complexities. David Cooper has been invited to present to the TTC Board in accordance with Section 11 of the TTC By-law to Govern Board Proceedings
The Toronto Transit Commission Board received the Presentation: Transit agency responses and trends addressing societal complexity on transit for information.
